campaign.title: M1 lower nonresonant cone rational-additive-spectrum gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary-source literature may be used only for exact rational additive transforms of divisor-type coefficients, Ramanujan or Voronoi expansions, rationally shifted square-root twists, or uniform exponent-pair and large-sieve estimates. Record theorem number, coefficient class, smoothing, rational denominator range, centre uniformity, absolute-value placement, and the full R- and q-power ledger.

frozen_target.question: Can the rational additive spectrum of the exact Round-141 cone coefficient be extracted uniformly enough to prove its fixed-centre nonresonant square-root twist, or to reduce it to a strictly smaller owner-complete rational-slope survivor; if not, what is the first exact denominator-uniformity, major-arc accumulation, periodic-branch, endpoint, source-hypothesis, self-return, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X=y^2+q_X with 0<=q_X<=2y, and C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r). On dyadic I_M=[M,2M) within m<=C_VN/R^2, put k_m=floor(sqrt(Nm)+1/2), j_m=k_m^2-Nm. The exact open scalar is T_nr=sum_M sum_(m in I_M, |j_m|>sqrt M)m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)C(m)e(sqrt(Nm)), with target |T_nr|<<_epsilon X^epsilon.
quantities: Round 141 proves the exact quarter-frequency asymptotic sum_(m<=M)C(m)e(m/4)=i*pi*M/8+O(M^(1/2)); it does not prove that 1/4 is the only rational main mode.

For a reduced rational alpha=a/q, unfold S_C(M;alpha)=sum_(4h^2<M)sum_(4h<r<=M/h, r odd)chi_4(r)e(alpha h r). Any row mean, residue class, main constant, and error must be derived with exact endpoints.
A fixed-q asymptotic is not a q-uniform major-arc theorem. Every use in local slope cells must state the allowed q range, arc width, overlap, endpoint convention, and total weighted q-sum.

Subtracting a finite periodic projection is useful only if its nonlinear square-root branch is target-safe and the residual has the exact additive partial-sum control required on every complementary slope cell.
The nonresonant condition |j_m|>sqrt M concerns phase values, not derivative distance. It may not be used as a rational-slope separation without a proved implication.
Raw rational-mode capacity, a main term in a coefficient Fourier transform, or a real radial cosine estimate is not a lower bound or bound for the signed fixed-centre complex scalar.
Round 141 supplies an unsquared scalar equivalence only. No lower GAR, direct M1, M9-M1, M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion follows without its separate owner.

completion_criteria: Derive the exact finite additive transform of C(m) at reduced a/q, including the condition for a nonzero row mean, its sign and constant, both cone endpoints, and an error uniform in a stated q range.
If rational main modes are subtracted, define the finite or infinite spectrum, convergence/order, denominator cutoff, residual coefficient, and exact reconstruction error.
Map local slopes of sqrt(Nm) to rational arcs with explicit widths, multiplicities, endpoint rules, nonresonant interaction, and total weighted capacity.
Prove every extracted periodic rational-shift square-root branch target-safe and the residual complement at X^epsilon before claiming a strict reduction.
Audit all source theorems against the actual cone or residual coefficient, rational denominator range, square-root centre, smoothing, and full R- and q-power ledger.
Test q not divisible by 4, q divisible by 4, q=4, both signs a/q, small and growing q, small and top M, q_X=0 and q_X=2y, and canonical self-return.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_rational_spectrum_reduction, or rational_major_arc_self_return_no_go.
Make no lower-GAR, direct blockwise M1, M9-M1, M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion unless every corresponding owner closes.

tasks.target: Derive the exact rational additive spectrum of the cone coefficient. Prove a fixed- and growing-denominator asymptotic for S_C(M;a/q), compute every nonzero main constant, and test whether a denominator-truncated spectral subtraction yields a residual with target-useful uniform additive partial sums and a target-safe reconstruction error.
required_output: An exact rational-frequency theorem with all constants and a complete M-, q-, and R-power ledger.
A target estimate, strict owner-complete rational-spectrum survivor, or first rigorous denominator-accumulation or reconstruction obstruction.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Independently decide from the exact cone scalar whether rational additive modes and local derivative cells prove the target or a strict reduction. Derive the rational row means, q-uniform errors, arc widths, periodic branches, and residual requirement without access to prior derivations; otherwise prove the first exact no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-138 through Round-142 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A self-contained rational-spectrum and local-slope derivation with exact endpoint and q-uniform controls.
A target estimate, strict signed survivor, or first rigorous no-go step.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Audit primary literature and exact transformations for rationally shifted coefficient-free square-root sums and Ramanujan or Voronoi expansions of divisor-type coefficients. Determine whether the extracted a/q branches and their denominator sum are target-safe uniformly at the Round-142 centre, or identify the first coefficient, q-range, smoothing, direction, or self-return obstruction.
required_output: Primary-source theorem cards and an exact B-process or Voronoi power ledger for each rational branch and the full denominator sum.
A usable target theorem or the first rigorous source-level and q-accumulation obstruction.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The exact row mean, q mod 4 condition, two residue classes, sign, main constant, and both cone endpoints are independently verified.
Every fixed-q asymptotic is distinguished from a growing-q theorem, with the exact error and useful denominator range stated.
Any finite or infinite rational-mode subtraction has a declared order, convergence law, residual coefficient, and target-safe reconstruction error.
Derivative arcs have exact widths, overlap and endpoint conventions, and are not confused with the accepted phase-value nonresonance condition.
Every rational-shift square-root branch and cited theorem has a complete dyadic R- and q-power ledger and preserves the required complex direction.
Only the Round-141 nonresonant cone scalar or a proved strict survivor may change; every square-level, downstream, and exponent claim requires its separate owner.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact cone coefficient has a uniform rational mean at every reduced denominator divisible by four, with coefficient i*pi*chi_4(a)/(2q) and error O((sqrt M+q)log(2q)). Finite cutoffs retain omitted modes; denominator-Abel completion returns r_2/4 and leaves the negative-character cone unchanged; the moving wedge, missing local residual norm, source hypotheses, and stationary-principal self-return prevent an owner-complete reduction. The frozen scalar remains open.
